lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A highly ordered rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the pectoral fin, organized into at least five observable horizontal tiers with consistent spatial frequency.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal blob tiers, creating a well-defined checkerboard-like coordinate system across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal feature exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient (high-value superior, low-value inferior) is visible along the upper flank, extending from the level of the first dorsal fin forward towards the branchial region.
